# Third Shot

> Pickleball strategy on a first-person 3D court. Read the ball and their feet, call the shot, then see it replayed against the right one. 15 balls a day free.

## App

- [Pickleball Strategy App for iPhone | Third Shot](https://jackwallner.com/ios/pickleball/index.html.md): Pickleball strategy on a first-person 3D court. Read the ball and their feet, call the shot, then see it replayed against the right one. 15 balls a day free.

## Guides

- [Third Shot Drop vs Drive in Pickleball: When to Use Each](https://jackwallner.com/ios/pickleball/third-shot-drop-vs-drive.html.md): Drop the third shot when both opponents are set at the kitchen. Drive when one is still moving or the ball sits up. A plain guide with the exact cues to read.
